subject.title: feat: add editable voice dictation to the Control UI

question: Should editable Control UI dictation be accepted as a core Gateway/provider-backed feature now, with a new operator-write microphone-audio transcription RPC?
rationale: The implementation direction is better aligned than direct browser Web Speech, but accepting browser microphone audio through Gateway media providers is a product and security-boundary choice that code review alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Continue after proof and fixes
options.body: Require a current-main port, the accessibility/docs-map fixes, successful redacted real behavior proof, and explicit maintainer acceptance before merge.

options.title: Pause behind the feature issue
options.body: Keep this PR and the linked issue open while maintainers decide the permanent Control UI dictation boundary and owner.

options.title: Supersede with a fresh branch
options.body: If the stale branch is too expensive to port, close or replace it with a narrower implementation against the current chat composer.

recommendation.title: Continue after proof and fixes
recommendation.body: Require a current-main port, the accessibility/docs-map fixes, successful redacted real behavior proof, and explicit maintainer acceptance before merge.
